% Interval bars as a plot option (no axis style): each bar spans
% [x_i, x_{i+1}]; two plots share each interval in slots. Behaviour U7.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}
  \addplot+[ybar interval=0.8, mark=none, fill=blue!20] coordinates {(0,2) (1,3) (3,1) (4,1)};
  \addplot+[ybar interval=0.8, mark=none, fill=red!20] coordinates {(0,1) (1,1.5) (3,2.5) (4,2.5)};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
